top_papers.title: Auditing Anonymous AI Models: A Four-Stage Protocol for Black-Box Identity Verification
top_papers.abstract: The 2025--2026 AI market has seen a wave of stealth releases: frontier models launched anonymously on developer platforms under codenames. For their users, identity determines data-handling terms, supply-chain risk, and capability expectations. top_papers.title: Context-Aware Interleaved Batching for WhisperX
top_papers.abstract: While WhisperX accelerates speech transcription via intra-audio batching, it isolates audio segments, losing the historical context needed for coherent punctuation and terminology transcription. Conversely, standard Whisper retains context sequentially but suffers from slow inference and hallucination loops. To achieve the best of both worlds, we propose Context-Aware Interleaved Batching. top_papers.title: On the Complexity of the Compatibility Problem for Succinctly Encoded Conditional Distributions
top_papers.abstract: The motivation for this paper is the investigation of the trade-offs implicit in probabilistic models used in machine learning.
